endpoint.selection: Published global endpoint or exact scoped override; no inferred region/pool
endpoint.ref_validation: Caller ResourceRef scope/service/generation/kind/endpointID/URL and root shape checked before credential/resource I/O

response.mapping: Typed FirewallRule id/action/address/ports, generated required fields and enum validation. Nonempty ID maps exact project-scoped root ref. Create scans identity before unrelated field decoding; replace requires returned ID equal exact caller ref, retains accepted caller ref on foreign/invalid response. List finite root array preserves partial collection at local bounds.

errors.mapping: Shared safe status taxonomy with documented400/401/403/404/409 as applicable; receipt on every mutation error including pre-I/O, no provider raw diagnostics.

pagination.provider: Finite native root array with no page/limit parameters
pagination.local: Bounded FixedIterator; truncation returns observed items and incomplete/SDK cursor
